$comment: The covers the platform register shows each game by. These are DERIVATIVES: each is a 900px JPEG re-encoded from that game's own 1200x630 key art, because a register that lists every game would otherwise carry 1.6 MB of PNG before it said a word. The re-encode drops the C2PA chunk and the invisible watermark, which is why sourceSha256 is recorded — the provenance of these files is the provenance of the file each came from. The catalogue that names them is src/art/titles.ts; nothing else in this repository spells these paths.
disclosure: Every image here is AI-generated. Each source file carries C2PA provenance and a Microsoft invisible watermark; the JPEGs served here are re-encoded derivatives and carry neither, so each one names the file it came from and that file's checksum.
